ValidationRule.description: For MLCRM - Checks if Lost Reason is not blank if Stage is Lost
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ISCHANGED(StageName), ISBLANK(TEXT(Lost_Reason__c)), AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Opportunity', ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Lost'))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a valid Lost Reason.
